reports.verdict: Apple beat on sales and profit, but guided December-quarter margins down to 45%–46% as record memory-chip costs cut into profit.

takeaways.label: Margin squeeze
takeaways.text: December gross margin is guided to 45%–46%, below the 47.9% just reported (about 1 point of which was one-time tariff refunds) and under the 46.3% analysts expected. Memory costs drive most of the drop.

takeaways.label: Record holiday growth
takeaways.text: Apple guided December-quarter revenue up 7%–10%, above the 6.1% analysts expected, and called it the best quarter in company history. It gave no outlook beyond December.

takeaways.label: Supply limits demand
takeaways.text: The new iPhone Duo is supply-constrained and Apple can't say when supply will meet demand. Mac and iPad supply will also be tight in December because of memory.

takeaways.label: Costs and softer spots
takeaways.text: Spending on AI-driven R&D is guided up 11%–13%. Services growth slows to 8%–9%, Greater China revenue of $17.5 billion missed estimates, and iPad and wearables fell.

reports.verdict: Revenue nearly doubled and U.S. business customers now outspend the U.S. government, but new-deal growth slowed sharply to 6%.

takeaways.label: Commercial overtakes government
takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue rose 148% to $984M, passing U.S. government revenue ($953M) for the first time. Total revenue rose 96% to $2.31B versus about $2.18B expected.

takeaways.label: Forecast raised again
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue guidance rose to about $8.53B (91% growth) from about $8.15B, versus roughly $8.2B expected. The Q4 forecast is about $2.65B, and profit margins stay near 62%.

takeaways.label: New deals lag revenue
takeaways.text: New contract value signed was up only 6% to $2.9B, and U.S. commercial signings rose 11%. Revenue is growing far faster than new bookings.

takeaways.label: International commercial stalls
takeaways.text: International commercial revenue grew 21% year over year but only about 1% from the prior quarter. Management gave no figures on Europe, and Germany's military is evaluating 30 AI tools.

reports.verdict: Refining windfall and a $20 billion 2027 buyback plan lifted shares.

reasons.label: Big refining rebound
reasons.text: Fuel-making profit more than doubled to $9.1 billion from $4.1 billion last quarter.

reasons.label: Huge 2027 buyback
reasons.text: Plans $20 billion of share repurchases in 2027, after $5.1 billion bought this quarter.

reasons.label: Strong cash, less debt
reasons.text: Free cash flow was $19.1 billion, and net debt fell by nearly $11 billion this year.

reports.verdict: Refining-driven profit beat expectations, lifting shares modestly despite lower production and oil prices.

reasons.label: Refining profits surged
reasons.text: Fuel margins pushed refining earnings to $4.9 billion from $1.1 billion a year earlier.

reasons.label: Beat on estimates
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $5.28 topped the roughly $4.89 analyst average.

reasons.label: Cash and debt gains
reasons.text: Free cash flow near $14.2 billion; net debt fell to $20.7 billion from $34.5 billion.

reports.verdict: Revenue beat estimates and AbbVie raised its outlook again, lifting the stock modestly.

reasons.label: Outlook raised again
reasons.text: 2026 profit guidance lifted to $13.95–$13.99 from $13.76–$13.96, and the dividend rises 5.2%.

reasons.label: Revenue beat estimates
reasons.text: Sales of $17.4B (up 10.3%) topped the roughly $17.3B analysts expected.

reasons.label: Immunology drugs surging
reasons.text: Skyrizi grew 22.7% and Rinvoq 23.9%, more than offsetting Humira's 31% decline.
